predictions: Pulled in a solid 16-7 in week 6 (dropping the remaining result to forfeit), and then once we finished the week 5 postponements, I ended with a pretty strong 17-7 there. That brings me to 95-48 for the season (66.4% correct), so despite my weak week 4 and my moderate week 3, I'm at about a two-for-one rate. I've gotten absolutely nuked in D division in the last three weeks, so that is now my worst division, at a pretty sad 11-13 so far. I'm within a pick of 0.500 with every last D team… sigh.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Bottoms Up @ Waddle In, Waddle Out. Waddle slipped in doubles in week 3 against Cork. Aside from that, neither of these two has been had by anyone. Heck, the Bottoms have only been held below 16 once (somehow by the 7th place team). Is this Waddle closing the gap down? Or is this the Bottoms pushing the rest of E at least two matches down? Bottoms are way balanced, 14-10.

Match #2: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Heart of Dartness. Oh, if only We Throw It hadn't dumped one to Flight Club last week. With Flight Risks crumbling a bit, this pairing shoulda/coulda/woulda been a duel of undefeateds for G supremacy. Instead, it's We Throw It just trying to even things up. Seems like Dartness's time though, 15-9.

Match #3: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Wing & A Plaque. Wing leads C despite losing 60% of their DCkts… that's just not a standard path. Meanwhile, the Niners have three of their last four, including a couple wins by 17-7 and 17-6. Everything seems to be pointing to an upset win by the Niners. So, obviously, I'll be sticking with Wing. 13-11.

Match #4: (B Div.) The Outlaws @ Raging Bulls. With the big win by Serious last week, the four-pack of teams behind them are left to fight among themselves to be the top contender. The Outlaws are only in this pack because they fell to a bottom-two team last week, so that's a little confusing. So maybe it's Raging moving up a bit, 13-11.

Match #5: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Darty Sanchez. Sanchez has now won three straight. Menace is now on their first losing streak (well, if one is a streak). Is this a changing of the guard at the top of D? Maybe… but I'm thinking Menace has just enough to get by here, 13-11.

Match #6: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ One Armed Bandits. Wing sits alone atop D, but they've only surpassed 14 points once, so they certainly seem reachable and all four 3-2 teams control their own fate. In that light, a critical pairing here. Secrets get it, 14-10.

Match #7: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Liquor Possee. Now that Menace has taken a loss, these two are right back in the title chase. And while both have dropped a couple matches, they're deep enough to take out anyone in this division. This is a tight one. Possee, 13-11.

Match #8: (G Div.) Flight Risks @ Flight Club. After quite a tough week, Flight Risks have gone from a lead trio contender to just one match and a handful of points from a bottom-two slot. I feel like the slide might continue and the Club moves up. Flight Club in 1001.

Match #9: (D Div.) Dirty Darts Done... @ One Dart Wonders. Dirty Darts rocked before Rick DeMattos left. Then they still won another. But then… a three-week collapse. And by the end of the day, they could be in a bottom-three spot. Instead, they win, 15-9.
Match #10: (B Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Hump Day! Only one B team is more than one win above 0.500. So matches in the middle pack like this are still VERY critical. Hump Day upset, 13-11.

Matches #11 & #12: (F Div.) Dart Knights @ Shark Shooters; Death Throw @ That's What She Said. The Shooters and She Said each sit at 0.500 and need to take advantage of their chances to take down one of the three teams ahead of them. Well, here's a shot for each. The problem is neither of those leaders is ready to drop one. The Knights reach the break at 6-1, 14-10; and DT ekes out a 13-11.
